+"""Automate release preparation: update version and release notes."""
+
+import argparse
+import re
+import sys
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def update_version(version: str) -> None:
+    init_file = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+    if not init_file.exists():
+        print(f"Error: {init_file} not found")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    content = init_file.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
+    init_file.write_text(new_content)
+    print(f"Updated version to {version} in {init_file}")
+
+def update_release_notes(version: str) -> None:
+    release_notes_file = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+    if not release_notes_file.exists():
+        print(f"Error: {release_notes_file} not found")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    content = release_notes_file.read_text()
+    
+    if f"## {version}" in content:
+        print(f"Version header ## {version} already exists in {release_notes_file}")
+        return
+
+    # Find the first versioned header
+    match = re.search(r"## \d+\.\d+\.\d+", content)
+    if match:
+        insert_pos = match.start()
+        prefix = content[:insert_pos]
+        
+        # Ensure there are two newlines before the new header
+        if not prefix.endswith("\n\n"):
+            if prefix.endswith("\n"):
+                new_prefix = prefix + "\n"
+            else:
+                new_prefix = prefix + "\n\n"
+        else:
+            new_prefix = prefix
+        
+        new_content = f"{new_prefix}## {version}\n\n{content[insert_pos:]}"
+        release_notes_file.write_text(new_content)
+        print(f"Added version header ## {version} to {release_notes_file}")
+    else:
+        # No versioned header found, append to the end
+        if not content.endswith("\n\n"):
+            if content.endswith("\n"):
+                new_content = content + "\n## " + version + "\n"
+            else:
+                new_content = content + "\n\n## " + version + "\n"
+        else:
+            new_content = content + "## " + version + "\n"
+        
+        release_notes_file.write_text(new_content)
+        print(f"Added version header ## {version} to the end of {release_notes_file}")
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Automate release preparation.")
+    parser.add_argument("version", help="New version (e.g. 0.136.4)")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    update_version(args.version)
+    update_release_notes(args.version)
+    
+    # Run add_latest_release_date.py
+    print("Updating release notes date...")
+    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"])
+    if result.returncode != 0:
+        print("Warning: scripts/add_latest_release_date.py failed. Make sure the release notes have the new version header.")
+    else:
+        print("Updated release notes date successfully.")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
